repositories.name: Babel Truth
repositories.notes: Owns transferable foundations, shared operating rules, semantic contracts, registry, and major architecture decisions.

repositories.name: Babel FIRE
repositories.notes: Owns FIRE production runtime, successor shell, FIRE-specific doctrine/specs/data/tests. V6 remains production. The G7 shell is explicitly frozen at approved runtime commit 4a258c5170dd1d96dcbc0f2b0a9c35b283cec489; FIRE Core breadboarding is unblocked. FIRE must explicitly adopt the newer Truth shell promotion before its pointer is called reconciled.

repositories.name: Babel Lab
repositories.notes: Lab is evidence, never authority. Active Fire/World experiments remain isolated from production runtime/data; there is no active full FIRE shell replica. Its provisional generic chrome should reconcile to the newly promoted Babel shell in a separate bounded pass, without blocking FIRE Core.

repositories.name: Babel World
repositories.notes: World experiments currently live under babel-lab/world/. A real World product earns its own repo later; Babel Lab itself does not become World.
